# Integrating tom_som_javascript_v0

<!-- GENERATED by tom_specs_clitool generate_som — do not edit by hand. -->

`tom_som_javascript_v0` is the typed TomSpecs object-model facade for JavaScript. It depends on `tom_som_javascript_runtime`. Both are versioned to the TomSpecs **model version** (currently `1.0.0`) — pin to that version so your document reads and writes match the model the facade was generated from.

## Quick start

Add `tom_som_javascript_v0` to your project (`npm install tom_som_javascript_v0`), then:

```javascript
const m = require('tom_som_javascript_v0');
const { SpecDocument } = require('tom_som_javascript_runtime');

// A typed Solution Blueprint over a fresh document.
const doc = new SpecDocument();
const blueprint = new m.D00SolutionBlueprint(doc);

blueprint.content = 'A platform that unifies our fragmented order systems.';
blueprint.currentLandscape.content =
    'Three legacy systems with no shared customer record.';

console.log(blueprint.content);
```

## Dependency routes

### From npm

Install the facade (it depends on `tom_som_javascript_runtime`):

```bash
npm install tom_som_javascript_v0
```

or pin it in your `package.json`:

```json
"dependencies": {
  "tom_som_javascript_v0": "^VERSION"
}
```

### Git dependency

npm cannot install a sub-directory of a git repository directly, and the facade lives in a sub-directory of the mono-repo — so clone first, then install by path (runtime first):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/al-the-bear/tom_ai_build.git
npm install ./tom_ai_build/tom_som_javascript_runtime
npm install ./tom_ai_build/tom_som_javascript_v0
```

### Path / link (monorepo / vendored)

When the SOM projects sit alongside your code, link both the runtime and the facade (runtime first):

```bash
npm install ../tom_som_javascript_runtime
npm install ../tom_som_javascript_v0
```

For a no-install checkout the facade also records the runtime location under `tomSom.runtimePath` in its `package.json`, so it resolves the runtime by relative path without a registered dependency.

## Pinning the version

Both `tom_som_javascript_runtime` and `tom_som_javascript_v0` carry version `1.0.0`, taken from the TomSpecs model version. When you upgrade the model, regenerate and move to the new matching version so the facade and your stored documents stay in step.

## Building from source

Regenerate the facade and dry-run the packages from the workspace:

```bash
dart run tom_specs_clitool/bin/generate_som.dart
cd tom_som_javascript_runtime && npm pack --dry-run
cd ../tom_som_javascript_v0 && npm pack --dry-run
```
